items.a: Tap the mic and speak — your voice is transcribed and translated in a few seconds, shown as text and available to hear read aloud. No typing needed.
186 languages. Pick your own language once, then start a conversation thread with anyone else's.

items.q: Do I need to create an account?
items.a: No. Try it right on this page with no sign-up. Sign in with Google only if you want a bigger monthly quota and history synced across devices.
Yes, per language pair, so past conversations stay organized — even without signing in, your browser is remembered. Clear or delete any thread anytime from its menu.

items.q: Can I use text instead of voice?

items.q: Does it work for two-way conversation?
items.a: Yes. Tap or swipe a translated line to flip between the original and the translation, so both sides can follow along on one screen.

translator.micBlockedDesc: You've blocked microphone access, so voice input can't work. Voice input needs the microphone to record your speech.
translator.micBlockedHow: To turn it back on: click the lock / site icon in the address bar, switch Microphone to Allow, then reload the page. On Safari: Preferences → Websites → Microphone → Allow. On iPhone/iPad: Settings → Safari → Microphone → Allow.
translator.micNotFound: No microphone found — check that it's connected and switched on, then try again.
translator.micBusy: The microphone is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
translator.micInsecure: Voice input only works over a secure https:// connection. Open the site via https:// and try again.
translator.micGeneric: Couldn't start the microphone. Try again.

pricing.heading: Simple monthly
pricing.sub: Every plan includes voice minutes and text characters. Try it free right on the homepage — no sign-up, no card.

freeNote.title: No free plan needed — the free tier is the homepage itself.
freeNote.sub: Translate without signing up: every visitor gets 2 voice minutes and 4,000 characters to try, right in the widget.

items.q: How do voice minutes and characters work?
items.a: Voice minutes cover turning your speech into text; characters cover translating text (including edited transcripts). Each plan refills both every month.

items.q: What happens when I run out?
items.a: Translation pauses until your monthly quota refills or you upgrade to a higher plan from the billing portal.

items.q: Is there a free way to try it?
items.a: Yes — the homepage widget works without any sign-up: 2 voice minutes and 4,000 characters are included for every visitor.
Yes. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime from the billing portal — no long-term commitment.
